"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/raw-stack-prerequisites-20261011/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    indirect = [Path(name) for name in (
        'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py',
        'scripts/record_value_observer_fact.py',
        'scripts/record_value_observer_namespace_fact.py',
        't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py',
        'docs/knowledge/record-value-original-observer-helper-paths.md',
        'docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')]
    inputs.update({str(path):pin(path.read_bytes()) for path in indirect})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    after={path:pin(Path(path).read_bytes()) for path in inputs}
    need(after==inputs,'complete direct and declared indirect source epoch conserved')
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Bind the complete fixed prerequisite domain before semantic reexecution."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, CLASS, OBSERVER, RAW, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, need, pin, save


def git(*arguments):
    actual=subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*arguments],capture_output=True)
    need(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'','complete fixed raw prerequisite Git protocol')
    return actual.stdout


def roots():
    directory=Path('docs/audits')
    raw=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(directory/'record-value-original-raw-20261005/binding.json')))
    classes=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(directory/'record-value-class-frame-join-20261006/binding.json')))
    address=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(directory/'address-raw-admission-20261010/admission.json')))
    selected=set(raw['archives'])|set(classes['inputs'])|set(address['custody']['roots'])
    names=git('ls-tree','-d','--name-only',REVISION+':docs/audits').decode().splitlines()
    families=('observer-','coordinate-','record-value-coordinate-','address-')
    selected.update(str(directory/name) for name in names if name.startswith(families))
    selected.update(str(directory/name) for name in ('record-value-original-raw-20261005',
        'record-value-class-frame-join-20261006','record-value-class-frame-publication-20261006'))
    selected.update(['scripts/check_record_value_publication.py','scripts/record_value_observer_fact.py',
        'scripts/record_value_observer_namespace_fact.py','scripts/record_value_address_fact.py',
        'scripts/record_value_coordinate_fact.py','t/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'])
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other+'/') for other in selected if path!=other))


def regular(path,mode):
    root=Path.cwd().resolve();full=root/path
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..','.git'}.intersection(path.parts),'own relative raw prerequisite path')
    need(full.resolve()==full and stat.S_ISREG(full.lstat().st_mode) and full.stat().st_dev==root.stat().st_dev,
         'ordinary same-volume raw prerequisite input')
    for parent in full.parents:
        if parent==root:break
        need(not (parent/'.git').exists(),'raw prerequisite repository boundary')
    need(bool(full.stat().st_mode&0o111)==(mode=='100755'),'complete raw prerequisite executable mode')
    return full


def derive():
    selected=roots();raw=git('--literal-pathspecs','ls-tree','-r','-z',REVISION,'--',*selected)
    entries={}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head,name=record.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid=head.decode().split();path=name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644','100755') and kind=='blob' and path not in entries,'complete regular raw prerequisite member population')
        entries[path]=dict(mode=mode,oid=oid)
    process=subprocess.Popen(['git','--no-replace-objects','cat-file','--batch'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    ledger={}
    try:
        for name,entry in sorted(entries.items()):
            path=regular(Path(name),entry['mode']);before=path.stat()
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode()+b'\n');process.stdin.flush()
            oid,kind,size=process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(oid.decode()==entry['oid'] and kind==b'blob' and int(size)==before.st_size,'whole fixed/current raw prerequisite object')
            remaining=int(size);digest=hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk=process.stdout.read(min(1048576,remaining))
                    need(bool(chunk) and stream.read(len(chunk))==chunk,'whole fixed/current raw prerequisite bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk);remaining-=len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1)==b'' and process.stdout.read(1)==b'\n','complete raw prerequisite object boundary')
            after=path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev,before.st_ino,before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns)==
                 (after.st_dev,after.st_ino,after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns),'complete raw prerequisite source epoch conserved')
            ledger[name]=dict(**entry,bytes=int(size),sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close();error=process.stderr.read();status=process.wait()
        need(type(status) is int and status==0 and error==b'' and process.stdout.read(1)==b'','complete raw prerequisite binary Git stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:process.kill();process.wait()
    observed=set()
    for selected_path in selected:
        path=Path(selected_path)
        if path.is_file():observed.add(str(path));continue
        for directory,children,files in os.walk(path,followlinks=False):
            base=Path(directory)
            for child in children:
                candidate=base/child
                need(not candidate.is_symlink() and not (candidate/'.git').exists(),'own raw prerequisite directory graph')
            observed.update(str(base/name) for name in files)
    need(observed==set(entries),'complete current and fixed raw prerequisite member graph')
    return dict(revision=REVISION,roots=selected,members=ledger,task=pin(git('show',REVISION+':docs/tasks/SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.md')),scope=SCOPE)


if __name__=='__main__':
    save('intake.json',derive())
    print('PASS complete fixed/current raw prerequisite source/native/product graph and binary byte custody before semantic joining.')

"""Retain every actual command, stream and complete program epoch, including failures."""
import subprocess
import sys
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin, save


def execute(label, command):
    previous = list(BASE.glob('actual-' + label + '-*.json'))
    name = 'actual-' + label + '-' + str(len(previous) + 1) + '.json'
    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
                  stderr=result.stderr, programs=programs)
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout[-500:], result.stderr[-1000:], flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,
         'actual complete successful step: ' + name)
    return record


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'label and explicit command required')
    execute(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])
